definitions.explanation: Following established rules or conventions; officially recognized.

examples.japanese: {正式|せいしき}な⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}んだ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧。
{正式|せいしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧⟦される→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{待|ま}っている→待つ：00469_matsu⟧。
examples.english: I'm waiting for the official announcement.

examples.japanese: ⟦これ→これ：00963_kore⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{正式|せいしき}な⟦{名前|なまえ}→名前：02234_namae⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ない→ない：01118_nai⟧。
examples.english: This is not the official name.

notes:
{正式|せいしき} is a na-adjective meaning formal or official.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {正式|せいしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (formally, officially)
- Noun: {正式|せいしき}さ (formality)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {正式|せいしき}な⟦{契約|けいやく}→契約：02698_keiyaku⟧ (formal contract)
- {正式|せいしき}な⟦{発表|はっぴょう}→発表：03562_happyou⟧ (official announcement)
- {正式|せいしき}な⟦{名称|めいしょう}→名称：12031_meishou⟧ (official name)
- {正式|せいしき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{決|き}まる→決まる：01233_kimaru⟧ (to be officially decided)
- {正式|せいしき}⟦{会員|かいいん}→会員：02535_kaiin⟧ (official member)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {正式|せいしき}: formal, official (proper procedure)
- ⟦{公式|こうしき}→公式：04167_koushiki⟧: official, formal (publicly recognized)
- ⟦フォーマル→フォーマル：11294_foomaru⟧: formal (borrowed from English, often for dress code)
